description:
Job Title: Researcher, Levant Region
Department: MENA Programs
Job Band: Researchers &Associates I
Compensation: Compensation will be commensurate with experience and includes consideration of the cost of living in the candidate’s individual location.
Term of Contract (Dates/Duration): Approximately August 24, 2026 - December 31, 2026
Location: Middle East/North Africa or Europe, remote, with a preference for Jordan or Lebanon
Workspace Designation: Remote
Reports to: Program Coordinator, Levant Region
Closing Date: August 21, 2026 (Candidates reviewed on a rolling basis)
About CPJ:
Founded in 1981, the Committee to Protect Journalists (“CPJ”) is an independent, non-profit organization defending journalists worldwide without regard to their political ideology. Through its work to safeguard journalists, CPJ protects the rights of all people to have access to diverse and independent sources of information. For over four decades, CPJ has helped win the early release of imprisoned journalists, secure convictions in journalist murders, and enable legal reform in countries where free expression has deteriorated. CPJ’s widely cited database and reports have raised global awareness of attacks on press freedom. Learn more about CPJ’s fight to defend freedom of the press here
At CPJ, we are dedicated to upholding values of equity and free expression in both our internal operations and external endeavors. As a global organization headquartered in the United States, we aspire to build a diverse workplace and foster an inclusive and welcoming environment. We strive for our people to be representative of the global community on which we report and to equip them with the opportunities and resources they need to learn and succeed.
CPJ is headquartered in New York City, but our team is truly global, with staff members and contributors based worldwide. This structure allows us to monitor and respond to press freedom threats in real-time, ensuring that journalists everywhere have the support they need.
Scope of Work:
The Levant Researcher will document, investigate, and report on press freedom violations and threats to journalists in the Levant with a focus on Lebanon, Israel and Palestine, and Jordan The role includes research and writing for CPJ’s editorial and advocacy output, maintaining up-to-date data on press freedom violations, and translating reports between Arabic and English.
This role requires a background in media, press freedom, and human rights in the MENA region, excellent research and English and Arabic writing skills, a solid understanding of journalistic standards, and the ability to work independently and proactively. You will collaborate with colleagues across different time zones, requiring strong interpersonal and project management skills. The Researcher must be available for at least one weekly team meeting and one all-staff meeting (typically 9am New York) to coordinate with colleagues in different regions. Additionally, this position may require occasional after-hours support in urgent cases. Candidates should ensure they can accommodate this schedule before applying.
This is a short-term, remote, full time contract position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension.
Key Responsibilities:

• Monitor press freedom violations in Lebanon, Israel, Palestine and Jordan, including arrests, censorship, attacks, and legal harassment of journalists and media outlets.

• Write daily news alerts, statements, and in-depth features on emerging press freedom issues.

• Translate materials to and from Arabic, including interviews, reports, and official documents, to support CPJ's reporting and advocacy.

• Write timely news alerts, public statements, and in-depth features on emerging press freedom issues across the Levant, with a particular focus on escalation zones such as Gaza, the West Bank and Lebanon.

• Coordinate investigative research efforts, including case mapping, open-source intelligence (OSINT) analysis

You will use modern AI tools to accelerate your workflow, stepping outside traditional engineering boundaries to assist with lightweight product management, data analysis and maybe even design tasks to get experiments live faster.

• Product-minded communicator: You possess strong product instincts and can articulate the "why" behind your technical choices to non-technical stakeholders. You thrive in an autonomous culture and enable co-workers through knowledge sharing.

TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST SNAPSHOT

Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.

This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.

You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.

The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.

Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.

We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.

You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.

You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.

More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.

YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Talent Sourcing

- Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.

- Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.

- Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.

- Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.

Candidate Qualification

- Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.

- Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.

- Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.

- Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.

- Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.

Sales Talent Acquisition

- Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.

- Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.

- Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.

- Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.

Candidate Experience

- Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

- Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.

- Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.

- Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.

Recruiting Operations

- Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.

- Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.

- Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.

- Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.

About the Role
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our core research and development team focused on recovering accurate 3D human body and hand motion from egocentric (first-person) video.
Human demonstration data is the foundation of robot learning, and its quality depends on accurately reconstructing human motion. In this role, you will develop models and production pipelines that transform head-mounted and body-mounted camera streams-including wide-FOV, stereo, motion-blurred, and heavily self-occluded video-into metrically accurate, temporally consistent 3D pose representations for robot policy training and human-to-robot motion retargeting.
You will work across the entire perception stack, including camera calibration, data annotation, model training, evaluation, and large-scale deployment. This role is ideal for engineers with strong expertise in both computer vision and deep learning who enjoy solving challenging real-world perception problems.
Responsibilities

• Develop state-of-the-art 3D body and hand pose estimation models for egocentric video using monocular and stereo camera systems.

• Build models for 2D/3D keypoint estimation, SMPL/SMPL-X, MANO, and full-body motion reconstruction.

• Address challenging egocentric vision problems, including severe self-occlusion, motion blur, rolling shutter artifacts, truncated limbs, extreme viewpoints, and hand-object interaction.

• Design and maintain camera geometry and calibration pipelines, including fisheye and wide-FOV camera models, stereo calibration, triangulation, and coordinate frame alignment.

• Improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility using filtering, kinematic constraints, multi-view fusion, and multi-modal sensor integration.

• Build scalable annotation, evaluation, and quality assurance pipelines for large-scale human motion datasets.

• Optimize large-scale model training and high-throughput inference pipelines for production environments.

• Collaborate closely with robotics engineers to convert reconstructed human motion into high-quality robot training data.

• Contribute to system architecture, engineering best practices, and the long-term evolution of the perception platform.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems.

• Hands-on experience with 3D human pose estimation, hand pose estimation, or human motion tracking from video.

• Strong understanding of multi-view geometry, camera calibration, triangulation, coordinate transformations, and projection models.

• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

title: Technik skladu a automatických linek
description:
Automatizované warehouse systémy a moderní dopravníky jsou srdcem našich skladů. V Rohliku technologie neprovozujeme pro efekt, ale proto, abychom zákazníkům doručovali nákupy rychle, přesně a v nejvyšší kvalitě. Do našeho skladu v Chrášťanech hledáme šikovného parťáka, který si vezme pod křídla technickou stránku automatických linek i kompletní údržbu celého objektu.

Nebudeš zavřený na jednom místě. Tvoje práce bude hodně pestrá - od bleskového řešení technických zádrhelů přímo v provozu až po zajištění toho, aby celé zázemí skladu fungovalo bez výpadků. Pokud se nebojíš dynamického provozu, rozumíš technice a chceš mít reálný dopad na hladký chod logistiky, jsi náš člověk.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Práce s moderní technologií: Budeš mít na starosti automatizované linky a pokročilé skladové systémy v plném provozu.

- Rozmanitost a samostatnost: Nečeká tě stereotyp. Jeden den řešíš preventivní údržbu, druhý den akční zásah přímo na lince nebo komunikaci s dodavateli.

- Přímý dopad na provoz: Na tvé práci závisí, jak rychle a spolehlivě expedujeme tisíce objednávek denně.

- Prostor pro rozvoj: Pokud ještě nemáš zkušenosti s automatizací, všechno tě naučíme - důležitá je pro nás technická logika a chuť se učit.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Údržba a plynulý chod celého skladu a jeho systémů - od technického zařízení budovy a regálových systémů až po moderní dopravníky a automatizované linky.

- Běžná preventivní údržba podle plánu i rychlé a operativní řešení nečekaných poruch přímo v provozu.

- Dohled nad dodržováním termínů pravidelných kontrol, servisu a revizí techniky.

- Vedení základní technické a facility administrativy (záznamy o opravách, kontrolách a údržbě).

- Práce v nepřetržitém směnovém provozu (střídání denních a nočních směn).

Co od tebe očekáváme

- Technické myšlení, manuální zručnost a schopnost poradit si s běžnými technickými opravami.

- Týmového ducha a komunikativnost - dokážeš se lidsky a jasně domluvit s kolegy v provozu i s externími dodavateli.

- Zkušenosti s údržbou, opravami nebo diagnostikou automatizačních linek jsou velkou výhodou (nikoliv však podmínkou - rádi tě zaškolíme).

- Chladnou hlavu a schopnost prioritizovat v krizových nebo nečekaných situacích.

Co ti nabízíme

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma: Nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Čas na odpočinek: Možnost placeného volna, když si potřebuješ vydechnout nebo zařídit osobní věci.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma: Dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti.

- Příspěvek na ošatné: Ke každé směně přihodíme 86 Kč navíc na pracovní oblečení.

- Ocenění za dobrou práci: Interní systém pochval (hvězdičky), které proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Sport & relax: Kartička MultiSport pro tvůj volný čas.

- Firemní kultura: Skvělý tým a společné oslavy úspěchů na firemních akcích.
